flaws.locator: Proposition 3.5, proof, the sentence 'By construction, D_xi -> xi x_k S is a family of A_xi[F]-torsors, and in particular, finite, flat, and radicial of degree p over xi x_k S, which establishes claim (1)': the erratum says the construction yields only a family of A_xi[p]-torsors, finite and flat of degree p, so the Frobenius-kernel torsor structure, and with it radiciality, is asserted without justification

statement_status.reference: S-0061, the erratum: 'the proof of Proposition 3.5 contains a mistake ... More precisely, the proof only shows the following: [a degree p multisection, finite and flat, arising from a family of A_xi[p]-torsors] ... contrary to what was claimed in Proposition 3.5, one may not be able to choose the degree p multisection D_xi to be radicial' - the statement is neither re-proved nor disproved
